connectors.boundary: Official reported merchandise/service trade; mirror asymmetry, revisions, gaps, and classification changes remain material.
licenseNotes: API access does not grant blanket redistribution rights; raw payloads are never bundled.
connectors.name: UN Comtrade
operationalNotes: Preview access is limited; free and premium subscription quotas differ.

connectors.boundary: Balanced country-industry accounts, not company supplier relationships or current operational flows.
licenseNotes: Users accept OECD terms when retrieving data; the repository stores queries and hashes.
connectors.name: OECD Inter-Country Input-Output tables
operationalNotes: Large TiVA spaces are rate limited; bulk partitions are preferred over unbounded API requests.

connectors.boundary: Issuer/fund filings and XBRL facts are entity-reported and may omit operational relationships.
licenseNotes: Government-created SEC content and issuer filing content have different authorship; raw archives are not bundled.
connectors.name: SEC EDGAR data APIs
operationalNotes: Declare a real user agent and remain below the SEC fair-access ceiling of 10 requests per second.

connectors.boundary: Legal-entity identity and reported accounting relationships are not commercial supply relationships.
licenseNotes: GLEIF provides LEI and LE-RD through the Access Service under CC0 1.0; do not imply GLEIF endorsement or affiliation.
connectors.name: GLEIF LEI API
operationalNotes: Ignore unknown response fields and prefer current plural successor relationships.

connectors.boundary: Country-reported agricultural statistics differ in coverage and quality; third-party datasets may carry exceptions.
licenseNotes: Default CC BY 4.0 applies unless dataset metadata states a third-party or other exception.
connectors.name: FAOSTAT
operationalNotes: A release must retain FAO attribution and the dataset-specific metadata record.
connectors.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

connectors.boundary: U.S. shortage records are not a global supply graph and must not be used for individual medical decisions.
licenseNotes: The Drug Shortages catalog is marked Public Domain and CC0; retain FDA attribution and do not imply endorsement.
connectors.name: openFDA Drug Shortages
operationalNotes: Current standard quotas differ with and without a free API key.

connectors.boundary: OFAC designations cover OFAC-administered programs only; the connector is not a legal compliance determination.
licenseNotes: Official hashes should be retained where available; the repository does not republish full lists.
connectors.name: OFAC Sanctions List Service
operationalNotes: SLS publishes current files, customizable datasets, and archived deltas.
connectors.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, OFAC

connectors.boundary: Trade/tariff indicators are aggregated and constrained by the selected source, nomenclature, and query dimensions.
licenseNotes: Underlying providers may impose terms in addition to World Bank dataset terms.
connectors.name: World Bank WITS API
operationalNotes: The API rejects whole-database queries; bounded dimensions and cached partitions are mandatory.

connectors.boundary: The published index is not the underlying carrier schedule or AIS dataset, and methodology revisions affect comparability.
licenseNotes: MDS Transmodal underlying data rights are not presumed redistributable.
connectors.name: UNCTAD Liner Shipping Connectivity Index
operationalNotes: Import a user-downloaded UNCTAD export with its metadata; no undocumented endpoint is scraped.
connectors.publisher: UN Trade and Development and MDS Transmodal

connectors.boundary: PortWatch indicators and simulations do not expose a complete firm/product supply network and may rely on third-party satellite/AIS inputs.
licenseNotes: Only user-provided lawful exports are imported; no platform data are bundled.
connectors.name: IMF PortWatch
operationalNotes: Import metadata must identify export time, fields, and applicable terms.
connectors.publisher: International Monetary Fund and University of Oxford
